panels.description: Himalayas, 2042 night: eighteen-year-old Roman hangs half-buried in a blue-white crevasse as his small silver Terrain Jumper descends toward him; lightning strikes the sensor housing. No red booties; leave upper-right clear.

Himalayas, 2026 day: floodwater carries a cooking pot and child’s red sweater past six-year-old Sitara seen from behind on a stone step as an adult hand pulls her away. Keep faces and cultural details nonspecific; leave upper area clear.
Antarctica, 2046: Sitara in her puffy red jacket stands beside Nayah in her puffy yellow jacket near warning flags, a buried sensor tripod, and Sitara’s separate silver TJ. Leave upper-left clear.

Sitara’s boot hovers just short of the flagged line; the sensor’s red light blinks while a geometric tremor advances beneath the ice. Leave upper-left for dialogue and lower-right for the sound effect.
